title: The Locked Wing
text: A door in the Seat that was never there opens onto a wing that was never built, its long corridors furnished, dusted and lamplit. The portraits on the walls are of your House. Some of the faces belong to Scions not yet born.

options.label: Walk into the wing that was never built, to learn what your House will become.

outcomes.text: You find a treasure room, dusty and real, with a portrait of you on the wall, older.
You find a nursery. The child in it knows your name.
The corridors only lead back to the door. Some of you never stop walking them in your sleep.

options.label: Brick it up; the future can stay behind a wall.

outcomes.text: For a week the bricks are warm, and something on the other side breathes against them.
